t.why: Since Sudan's civil war, more than 870,000 new refugees have arrived, pushing the number of Sudanese refugees in Chad above 1.2 million. It ended military cooperation with France in 2024.
t.rel: A landlocked country surrounded by six neighbors. It is directly affected by Sudan's civil war and fights armed groups together with the countries around Lake Chad. It ended military cooperation with France in 2024, and French troops left.
t.know: Lake Chad has shrunk dramatically since the 1960s.
t.etext: Crude oil makes up most exports, along with livestock and cotton. It has taken in many refugees from Sudan's civil war.
